note: EXP-07 step 3a, the one-wall test: patch_exp07hide's hider (the bar out of play) plus copies of the bar's solid back wall Core_384BackA (XComDecoFracLevelActor_7, pivot (-1056, 672, 16)) on the cleared ground, turned 90 degrees so that each runs north-south over y about 85..1259. Runs 1-3: see EXP-07 (run 3: the plain-mesh copy is lit, the fractured copy black; F-28). Run 4, five copies about 3 tiles apart, west to east, each a lighting variant: 1 at x about -1835, XComMapEdWall with its own light environment, and a test point light (XComMapEdLight, radius 320) at (-1900, 300, 150) by its north end; 2 at x about -1547, the plain-mesh copy (XComMapEdLevelPiece), lit in run 3, as the reference; 3 at x about -1259, XComMapEdWall without environment shadowing; 4 at x about -971, XComMapEdWallStaticIB (the static index buffer); 5 at x about -683, XComMapEdWall with the lit overlay while whole (the fractured mesh is swapped in at the first damage). Copy objects come first so that they read the sources before the hider changes them. Run 5: the same five walls; the copier also logs, 5 s after load, every wall's tile data (cover flags and occupancy two tiles either side, IsAdjacentTileVisible across the wall, WorldTrace across at 80 and 160 units), and each wall copy logs its fragment columns (run 4: all four fractured variants were lit, and a soldier at tile (21,23) by wall 5 saw through it; F-29). Run 6: the hider runs the game's full world data build (BuildWorldData) once after hiding, before its usual rebuild (run 5: a runtime rebuild re-checks a tile above the ground only where the baked data had something, so copied walls on tiles that were empty don't block line of sight). Run 6 crashed the game inside BuildWorldData (3.6 s in), so the full build is off again. Run 7, tile tests against run 5's results at the same spots: wall 1 XComMapEdWallNoStatic (bStaticCollision off; the test light dropped), wall 3 not world geometry, wall 4 XComMapEdWallNoStatic and not world geometry, wall 5 as run 5 (repeatability), wall 2 the plain copy. Run 7 matched run 5 row for row on every wall: neither bStaticCollision nor bWorldGeometry off changed anything. Run 8: wall 1 (XComMapEdWall) has its tiles above the ground marked as water before the rebuild (SetIsWaterTile), cleared and rebuilt again 5 s after load and logged 5 s later; walls 3 and 4 are back to run 5's classes; the tile log adds each tile's visibility-map index and the world's tile counts. Run 8: the world stores all 52x39x12 tiles (the visibility index is the plain grid index), and marking wall 1's tiles as water changed nothing. Run 9: the first copier sets XComWorldData.UpdateBuildHeightTiles before its rebuild (no water marks). Run 9: UpdateBuildHeightTiles was read (the game cleared it) but changed nothing. Run 10: wall 1 plain again; two destructible props are copied onto tiles that were empty in the baked data, beside wall 1: a moving-van side panel (XComDestructibleActor_97, MovingVanWallF, 214 high) along the tile 8/9 edge over rows 23-25, and a diner oven (XComDestructibleActor_51, 161 high) on tile (8,22); the copier logs their tiles. Run 11: walls 1 and the two props block wherever their tiles were seeded by hand in the map's baked data (tools/upk/seed_tiles.py). Run 12: the same patch, seeded by patchtool from its own plan (map.name URB_Bar): every copy's tiles, walls 1 to 5, the panel and the oven, seeded in the lab's URB_Bar.upk at deploy, plus an XComMapEdTileSeeds actor that rebuilds them at load.
